summary: A fieldset that groups RadioButton options under a shared legend and controls which single option is selected.

alternatives.when: Users can select more than one option from the group.
Users choose one option from a very long list.
Users choose one option from a highly visible range.

pitfalls: RadioButtonGroup is controlled: update value from onChange. It applies name to every RadioButton child and checks the one whose value matches.
Provide a legend; it names the fieldset and is where the required indicator appears.
Pass validation messages as error on the group; warning is deprecated and not supported for grouped inputs.
Setting inline disables progressiveDisclosure on every RadioButton in the group.
